items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families
items.claim: Take a census of the sons of Gershon organized by families throughout their ancestral houses
items.object: the sum of the sons of Gershon
items.place: throughout the houses of their fathers

items.quote: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation
items.claim: Number the sons of Gershon aged 30-50 who perform service in the tabernacle
items.mechanism: thirty years old and upward until fifty years old
